title: Down Is Forever - Joginder Tanikella - An endless faller where you descend into a mind instead of running through a world [Android/iOS]
author: itzprobablyme
selftext:
I’ve just released Down Is Forever, a game built around a simple idea: what if an endless runner went vertically down?

You play Dr. Anya Rao of the Deepwell Institute, entering a mindscape in search of the root memory buried somewhere below.

The deeper you fall, the environment changes, the hazards get harder, and fragments of the mind begin to surface. It’s a one-touch game built around falling, steering, avoiding obstacles and trying to get deeper each time.

I’ve wanted to build and release a mobile game for years. I started programming with GW-BASIC, then moved through Turbo Basic, Visual Basic, C# and eventually tried building games for J2ME and Symbian. I could write the logic, but art and creating the kind of 3D world I had in my head were always difficult for me to pull off alone.

Then I found Godot. More recently, AI-assisted tools helped me bridge some of the gaps that had kept me from finishing a game by myself. Down Is Forever became the project where I finally took an idea all the way to a finished Android and iOS release.
